name: Document Loader Plugin - API
description: Document Loader plugin for loading data from API endpoints.
project_description: Document Loader Plugin - API registers a single DocumentLoader plugin (id document_loader:api, class ApiLoader extending DocumentLoaderBase) with the document_loader module's plugin manager. Given an ApiInput (URL, HTTP method, optional headers and body), ApiLoader::load() performs one HTTP request through Drupal's http_client (Guzzle), decodes the JSON response body (falling back to ['content' => <raw body>] when the response is not valid JSON), and converts the decoded data into one of six output formats — markdown (default when none is given), json, yaml, text, csv, or toml. Each result is wrapped in the matching document_loader Output value object (MarkdownOutput, JsonOutput, YamlOutput, TextOutput, CsvOutput, TomlOutput) together with request metadata (source URL, method, status_code, content_type, fetched_at). TOML serialization is handled by the bundled TomlFormatter utility; markdown/text/csv conversion is implemented inline in ApiLoader. The module ships no routes, permissions, configuration, services, or hooks of its own — it is a purely programmatic extension of the document_loader pipeline. It does NOT define a plugin type; it provides a plugin instance of document_loader's DocumentLoader plugin type. An optional submodule, document_loader_plugin_api_tool, exposes the loader as a Tool-API tool so AI agents and other Tool consumers can fetch and transform API responses.
